Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Thanks for taking a look — EdgeWorks is evaluating vendors to support a two-region deployment for a healthcare pilot in Germany and Japan. The core ask: can your platform (and local partners) guarantee data residency for PII and logs, and what tooling integrations (KMS, local HSM, SFTP ingest, SI connectors) are available for local SIs to operate under customer-managed networks?

I've attached a short requirements doc and would appreciate a quick inventory of what Redwood, plus any recommended local SIs, can support out of the box vs. via integration. Our timeline is tight: pilot kickoff in Q3, procurement finalized by early August.

Attachments: EdgeWorks_requirements_v1.pdf

Can we schedule a 30 min triage this week? Prefer Tue/Wed mornings CET.

Thanks — Claire

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and the doc. 

Quick summary up front: Redwood supports the three deployment modes you know (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private). For strict EU residency we typically propose Redwood Private in a customer VPC or our EU-dedicated cluster with customer-managed KMS. For local operations in Japan we pair Redwood Private with certified SIs that can manage networking and HSMs on-prem.

I've attached a starter inventory template (regional-tooling-inventory.csv) and a one-page Mutual Action Plan (redwood-map-template.docx) — would you mind filling the CSV with the EdgeWorks toolchain entries (KMS provider, logging sink, ETL ingress method, SI preference)? That will let us triage gaps quickly.

Proposed triage slots (CET):
- Tue 2027-05-25 09:00-09:30 CET
- Tue 2027-05-25 11:00-11:30 CET
- Wed 2027-05-26 08:00-08:30 CET

If those don't work we can open an afternoon CET slot. Agenda: 1) map required integrations to Redwood features (KMS, SFTP/FTP drops, SCIM/SSO), 2) identify SI partners in DE/JP who have audited processes, 3) list immediate blockers for procurement.

Short answers to your questions now:
- KMS: customer-managed KMS supported for Private and Dedicated; we integrate with AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and can coordinate with partner HSM vendors for on-prem enclaves.
- Logs: audit logs can be pushed to a customer S3-equivalent or to SI-managed logging pipeline (we publish schema).
- SI connectors: we maintain an integrations catalog; for EU we commonly recommend Marissa's list (I'll loop her in).

Would you like us to include technical SI contacts in the triage?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

Sofia — thanks, this is helpful. I filled the top section of the CSV with our current stack (GCP KMS in EU region, Splunk for logs, SFTP for batch ingest, Tekura SI preference in DE). Leaving the SI contact column blank for you to suggest.

A couple of clarifying Qs before the triage:
1) For EU KMS: will Redwood's Dedicated cluster be able to use our GCP KMS instances in eu-west1 without cross-region key access?
2) For APAC / Japan: Tekura says they can run a local enclave but require a supported connector for an HSM (PKCS#11) and a deterministic audit log export. Do you have a prebuilt connector or do we plan an integration project?

We can take Tue 2027-05-25 11:00 CET. Please send a calendar invite with the proposed agenda.

Thanks — Claire

Sofia / team — capturing quick internal triage notes ahead of the call with EdgeWorks at Tue 11:00 CET. Forwarding Claire's last message below for context.

--- Internal notes ---
Action owners:
- Marissa: compile EU SI shortlist (Tekura alternative + audit status) and map contactability; deliverable EOD Mon 2027-05-31.
- Vanessa: confirm KMS binding behavior for Dedicated (can GCP KMS be used without cross-region key export?) and write a one-paragraph position we can share in-call.
- Vivek: scope the HSM connector options — we have two paths: 1) use our existing PKCS#11 shim + partner HSM (2-3 week work) or 2) recommend Tekura run an enclave with on-prem HSM and use SFTP + log-forwarding as short-term. Provide rough effort estimates for both.

Preliminary inventory (from public docs + partner notes):
- KMS: AWS KMS, Azure KV supported; GCP KMS support exists but requires validation on Dedicated — Vanessa to confirm.
- Logging: audit schema published; can push to S3/GCS-compatible endpoints; Splunk ingestion feasible via partner pipeline.
- HSM: no turnkey managed HSM in Private yet; we do have a PKCS#11 shim used by some partners.

Talk track for call: 
1) Confirm EdgeWorks' KMS topology and whether they need key material to leave their Google project. If yes, we must discuss Private in their VPC or a Dedicated cluster with KMS peering.
2) For Tekura: confirm HSM requirements and whether they prefer Redwood build vs. partner-managed enclave.
3) Outline a 6-week integration path vs. a 2-week temporary workaround (SFTP + log-forwarding).

I'll pull the SI shortlist and send before the call. Anything else to add?
